Isikrini sokufinyeleleka se-Android siyaxwayisa ngakho konke isevisi enje engakwenza. Lena icindezela kuphela inkinobho yesistimu uma uyicela ukuba yenze njalo.

Ngokufinyelela kokusetshenziswa, ikhibhodi irekhoda ukuthi yiluphi uhlelo lokusebenza olwalungaphambili lapho ukopisha okuthile. Ibonisa lolo hlelo lokusebenza uma ucindezela ubambe isiqeshana. Ikhibhodi ifunda uhlelo lokusebenza olungaphambili kuphela ngesikhathi sokukopisha. Ayifundi umlando wakho noma isikhathi sakho kuhlelo lokusebenza. Ikhibhodi igcina impendulo nesiqeshana, kudivayisi yakho kuphela. Akukho okumayelana nokusetshenziswa kohlelo lwakho lokusebenza okuphuma kudivayisi yakho. Lesi silungiselelo singokuzikhethela. Sihlala sivaliwe uze usivule.
